description: DNSSEC check — Is DNSSEC working for a domain? SECURE / UNSIGNED / SIGNED BUT NOT DELEGATED / BROKEN verdict from a validating resolver, with DNSKEY and DS record counts, signing algorithms, and the fix to apply. A BROKEN result means the domain is unreachable for many users. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: dns_dnssec
